title: 第两千六百五十五章你怎么来了第两千六百五十四章你没有多余的选择
slug: 开局成为首座签到极道帝兵
lines: 帝主面色一沉，他生平最恨别人拿这些东西威胁他，女子无疑触碰了底线。
看见帝主的神色，院长和凤凰帝尊一左一右绕开，与帝主形成三角将女子夹在中间。
这么做，并不是说两人与帝主关系有多好，只是因为三人都来自低层天宇。
同为帝盟的一员，帝主有事他们若是看着，那等到他们有事的那一天，帝主也只会看着。
一旁的无之神主并无任何表示。
她不是低层天宇之人，更非帝盟成员，没有帮忙的理由。
“想要出手吗？这方天地已被我封锁，可以满足你们，不过后果自负。”
面对三人的包夹，来自高家的女子依旧非常平静，并不把三人放在眼里。
三个低层天宇的土著能成什么气候？
不说三人，就算把帝盟所有霸主都叫来，也不是她一招之敌。
帝盟这种小势力，只是因为当今时事才能够侥幸存在并霸占低层天宇而已。
放在过往，如帝盟这种公然违抗高层天宇命令的势力早就被打灭了，根本不会存在。
帝主三人换了个眼色，都摸不清女子的实力，对方修炼了特殊之法，将真实修为隐藏了，唯一可以确定的是女子很强！
“你们不出手，我可要出手了？敬酒不吃吃罚酒可就不要怪我了！”女子很强势。
她轻挥手掌，带起的法则海无比恐怖，瞬间就将院长和凤凰帝尊震飞出去。
院长和凤凰帝尊脸色一白，瞳孔震惊。
女子竟是一位跨入了第三层次的顶级霸主！
以他们目前的修为碰上这等级别的强者，和找死没有任何区别！
击退两人后，女子看向帝主，抓向前去，可怕的力量横压一切，令帝主动弹不得。
就在女子将要抓到帝主脖子的瞬间，帝主突然抬手挡住了女子的手，女子瞳孔一缩，目露惊色，帝主竟然能挡住她一击？
院长和凤凰帝尊对视一眼，同样能看到对方眼里的震惊。
帝主的实力竟然已经到了如此地步？
帝主趁机向后退去，想要遁走。
女子针对的是他，只要他离开了，对方就不会为难院长和凤凰帝尊。
“你以为你能走？”
女子目光中多了一丝认真，强大的气息封锁天地八方，堵死了帝主的路。
帝主冲还准备出手的院长和凤凰帝尊摇头，女子针对的是他，两人没必要卷进来。
他清楚高家是何等存在，卷进这种纷乱中对两人没有任何好处。
帝主还想要走，只见这时女子忽然开口说道：“执意要走？确定不考虑考虑你的道侣还有你女儿的安危？”
帝主身体一顿。
趁此机会，女子出手，一圈又一圈法则锁链将帝主捆住，封住了他的行动。
“以她相要挟？她可是你族圣女。”
帝主冷冷注视着女子。
“我族圣女？如今谁还记得她是我族圣女，恐怕她自己都忘了。”
女子平静的语气中多了一抹冷意，“她执意跟你离开时，可有想过自己是我族圣女？”
“我族为她铺的路，全都毁了！”
女子走到帝主面前，上下审视他，“真不知道她看上了你哪里，堂堂高家圣女，未来的高家圣主，竟和一个没有实力更没有背景的野小子私自跑去了低层天宇，贻笑大方！”
帝主冷漠盯着女子：“你族要如何不妨直说！”
女子低低冷笑了声，气质出尘，明眸美丽，她说道：“我族知道你们在哪里，但你知道我族为何一直没去寻她吗？”
content_en:
The emperor's face darkened. He hated people the most in his life for using these things to threaten him. The woman had undoubtedly touched the bottom line.
Seeing the emperor's expression, the dean and the Phoenix Emperor walked around to the left and right, forming a triangle with the emperor and sandwiching the woman in the middle.
This is not because the relationship between the two and the emperor is very good, but because the three of them are from the lower Tianyu.
As members of the Imperial Alliance, if they watch when something happens to the Emperor, then when something happens to them, the Emperor will only watch.
The Lord Wu on the side didn’t say anything.
She is not from the lower Tianyu, nor is she a member of the Imperial Alliance, so she has no reason to help.
"Do you want to take action? This world has been blocked by me. I can satisfy you, but you will be responsible for the consequences."
Facing the three people's double-teaming, the woman from the Gao family remained very calm and did not take the three people seriously.
What kind of climate can the natives of the three lower heavens have?
Not to mention the three people, even if all the overlords of the Imperial Alliance were called, they would not be able to defeat her with one move.
A small force like the Imperial Alliance was able to survive and dominate the lower sky only because of current events.
In the past, forces such as the Imperial Alliance that blatantly disobeyed the orders of the high-level Tianyu would have been destroyed long ago and would not exist at all.
The three emperors and masters looked at each other. They couldn't figure out the woman's strength. The other party had practiced a special method to hide her true cultivation level. The only thing that was certain was that the woman was very strong!
"If you don't take action, am I going to take action? Don't blame me if you don't drink wine as a penalty!" The woman was very strong.
She waved her palm lightly, and the sea of ​​laws she brought up was extremely terrifying, instantly sending the dean and the Phoenix Emperor flying away.
The dean and Phoenix Emperor's faces turned pale, and their pupils were shocked.
The woman is actually a top overlord who has entered the third level!
With their current cultivation level, meeting a strong person of this level is no different from seeking death!
After repelling the two men, the woman looked at the emperor and grabbed forward. The terrifying power overwhelmed everything, making the emperor unable to move.
Just when the woman was about to grab the emperor's neck, the emperor suddenly raised his hand to block the woman's hand. The woman's pupils shrank and she looked shocked. How could the emperor block her attack?
The dean and the Phoenix Emperor looked at each other, and they could also see the shock in each other's eyes.
The emperor's strength has actually reached such an extent?
The emperor took the opportunity to step back, trying to escape.
The woman was targeting him. As long as he left, the other party would not embarrass the dean and the Phoenix Emperor.
"You think you can leave?"
There was a hint of seriousness in the woman's eyes, and the powerful aura blocked the world and blocked the emperor's way.
The emperor shook his head at the dean and the Phoenix Emperor who were still ready to take action. The woman was targeting him, and there was no need for them to get involved.
He knew how important the Gao family was, and getting involved in this chaos would not do any good to the two of them.
The emperor still wanted to leave, but then the woman suddenly said: "You insist on leaving? Are you sure you don't want to consider the safety of your Taoist companion and your daughter?"
The Emperor's body trembled.
Taking advantage of this opportunity, the woman took action and bound the emperor with chains of law one after another, sealing his movements.
"Blackmailing her? She is a saint from your clan."
The Emperor looked at the woman coldly.
"My clan's saint? Who still remembers that she is our clan's saint? I'm afraid she herself has forgotten."
There was a hint of coldness in the woman's calm tone, "When she insisted on leaving with you, did she ever think that she was a saint from our clan?"
"All the roads my clan paved for her have been destroyed!"
The woman walked up to the emperor and looked him up and down, "I really don't know what she saw in you. The dignified saint of the Gao family, the future saint of the Gao family, actually ran away to the lower heavens secretly with a wild boy with no strength and no background. It's ridiculous!"
The emperor stared at the woman indifferently: "You might as well just tell me what your clan wants!"
The woman sneered in a low voice, with an extraordinary temperament and beautiful eyes. She said: "My clan knows where you are, but do you know why our clan has never looked for her?"
